title: Share links now carry their visual preview
summary:
A small garden-maintenance day: better link previews, a less fussy frontend, and clearer agent integration tracking.

The missing SEO image was fixed, so pollinations pages can present the intended image when they travel through search engines and link previews.

A frontend-side content filter was removed, leaving the interface closer to the capabilities exposed by the underlying platform rather than adding a separate browser gate.

Repository integration tracking and documentation were added to pollinator-agent, making its connections to the wider code garden easier to follow and maintain.
